# Oracle diff: wave-7 GT (W11 garnishee on a termination run, PAYROLL_CALCULATION_VERSION 23)

One row per case. "Before" is this branch's engine with `payrollGarnishee.ts` and `payrollCalculator.ts` restored to the
W53 merge `0336fa955c` (version 22: an off-cycle line took no garnishee, the oracle's new `balance` / `takenThisMonth` /
termination flag reach a calculator that ignores them); "after" is this branch (version 23). Figures are `runCase`'s over
all six oracle fields; only the asserted fields are printed. Delta = after − before, in cents, summed over all six fields.
"Expected warnings" is the case's `expectedWarnings` (— = absent, not asserted). `expected` is never edited (wave-6 §1
rule 6). Regenerated by a throwaway dump of `runCase` over every fixture.

Result: **no existing case moves** (GA's two regular-run cases keep their figures: `takenThisMonth` absent, no termination
flag). The four new cases are hand-computed in their notes and equal them within the documented 4 c AN tolerance on the
leave pay's PAYE (as `offcycle-termination-leave-after-regular`). All four are UNVERIFIED (statutes read and Hein's
rulings 6 and 15; no SARS guide or vendor figure) and on `unverified.json`. No `knownGaps.json` change.
On the four new cases "before" is the version-22 calculator fed the orders, so it applies the regular rule (25% of a
nil 3601 basic salary for attachments, maintenance taken from all net pay, `takenThisMonth` ignored); production at
version 22 passed no order to an off-cycle line at all, so its net there was the pay less PAYE and UIF.
